preconditions: Open index.html in a JavaScript-enabled browser; no server or packages are needed.
Choose only the supplied synthetic profiles; no real replay or supplied endpoint is supported.
Every production request records one synthetic profile-view write and one synthetic notification.
The candidate attempts the same effects through a separate sink, suppressed except in the explicitly unsafe fixture.
cleanup: Reset clears all in-memory observations and restores controls. Reload or close also discards state. No storage, cloud resources, background work or external effects exist.
limits: Response bodies and counters are deterministic synthetic observations, not live service measurements.
The UNKNOWN fixture withholds the candidate response after a suppressed effect attempt; its effect counts do not prove a real candidate is safe.
Matching bodies are not proof of safe external effects, performance, authorization, compatibility or readiness.
